if: goods are removed for transportation in one of the four cases in rule 55(1)(a) to (d)
a delivery challan is issued in lieu of an invoice under rule 55(1)
then: the delivery challan MUST carry its own date and number
note: One mandatory particular of rule 55(1)(i), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: date and number of the delivery challan;
